caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a decorated leather pouch or holster, centrally positioned against a plain, off-white background. The object is primarily made of brown leather, with visible stitching along the edges. The central section of the object features a rectangular panel filled with geometric embroidery in blue, white, yellow, and light brown threads, forming diamond and square patterns in a repeating sequence. There is a flap or strap at the top right of the object, also in brown leather, with stitched detailing, and an additional curved strap at the bottom left. The overall composition emphasizes the embroidered panel and the crafted leatherwork, with no additional objects or background details. The artist's signature, "Edith Turner," appears in small text at the bottom right corner.
title: Spur Cover
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
